NEW EVENTS — ARMOR, WEAPONS AND HEIRLOOMS, ARM-46 to ARM-95 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the dash before its text

collection.description: A ceremonial blade is used only to cut the first stalk of each year's harvest.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: A ceremonial blade is used only to cut the first stalk of each year's harvest. When it chips, the village debates whether a chipped blade still counts, and (name1), the oldest farmer, says the stalks have never complained.
